All application requirements of the project, one line each.

## Requirements

- **REQ-001** — Catalog listing. A shopper browses the products on offer. *(Source: Catalog)*
- **REQ-002** — Cart holds items. A shopper keeps picked items until checkout. *(Source: Cart, draft)*
